name: Great Plains Zoo Junior Zookeeper (JZK)
what_you_do: Teens volunteer all summer at the zoo. First-year jobs are helping at ZooCamp or greeting guests and running story time. Returning teens can care for farm animals and present animals.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 18 on June 1, 2027. Animal Care Assistants must be at least 14 and have done JZK the summer before. Advanced JZK is for returning 17 year olds.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Teens pay a fee after they are accepted: $85 for zoo members, $100 for non-members. It covers materials and two uniform t-shirts. Scholarships may be available.
duration: Whole summer; the 2027 session runs June 7 to Aug 15. At least two half-day shifts a week.
deadline_text: 2027 applications for returning teens close March 6, 2027. New teens apply in March and the last day is April 1, 2027. Interest Night is March 2, 2027. Email Education@GPZoo.org to be told when applications open.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Then go to a 20 minute in-person interview. After you are accepted, pay the fee. Give a negative TB test by orientation. Then go to orientation.
notes: Teens arrange their own lunch and transportation. Contact: Education@GPZoo.org or (605) 367-7003. Interviews are March 20 and 21 for returning teens and April 17 and 18 for new teens, 2027. The fee and TB test are due at kickoff on April 30, 2027.
